headline: Youth allegedly killed by bullet in Faridpur village clash, 15 injured
summary: A youth was allegedly killed by a bullet during a violent clash between two villages in Faridpur, which also left 15 people injured. The incident reportedly involved torchlights and escalated into a bloody confrontation.
details: A violent clash reportedly broke out between two groups of villagers in Faridpur, resulting in the alleged death of a youth from a bullet wound.
The confrontation, described as bloody, also left 15 other individuals injured. Reports indicate that torchlights were used during the nighttime incident.
